exploration.title: Build Pipeline Simplification
openQuestions: Does the operator accept the deep-research framing (library build = declaration pipeline; no bun build for libraries; two-tier effect-tsgo emit + tsdown only for public packages)? Both experiments came back as the framing predicted.

SchemaCompiler: the operator believes bundle-size and runtime wins exceed what is on file (+2 KB AOT / +7 KB JIT over an 18 KB baseline; 1.2x-1.5x on S.Class rows). Which mechanism or newer numbers support that, and does it move the compiler from per-app to per-library placement?
Should a shared build-kit package (NET-NEW) own the generated beep:build script, the dist/.d.ts assertion and the tsbuildinfo purge, replacing the two-line tsc && babel pair in 123 manifests?
Is the Babel annotate-pure-calls pass (1,808 markers on @beep/schema; the only pure-annotation source measured) worth keeping for private packages, or only for publishConfig.access public ones?
